OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her element shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never as armor, regalia or a costume. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

WORLD: this scene happens inside her own kingdom, the Oxygen Nation, as if she simply lives there — a sanctuary of forest and sea: breathing ancient trees, a coral temple at the shore, an eternal sacred flame that never consumes its altar, clean bright air. Its architecture, props, light and weather show the world; no creatures, no second character, no readable text other than her element's own symbol and atomic number. Her clothes stay the everyday outfit SCENE describes, not regalia or armor.

SCENE (chosen):

Outfit: a satin lounge set of button shirt and shorts
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; back to the camera; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds an umbrella open over her shoulder; it is all she holds.

overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis

Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her element belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her element's palette, materials, patterns or regalia.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera exactly as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same. ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her. No logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (O) and atomic number (8) — those two may appear readably (engraved, stamped, glowing or on a sign or label); nothing else is written.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.
